verdict.rationale: Granola ships a few event-driven automations of its own: a Zapier integration to "automate what happens after a meeting", folder-based rules that auto-sync notes to HubSpot CRM records, auto-drafted follow-up emails after external meetings, and automatic enhanced-note generation when a call ends. However, user-defined rule logic lives mostly in Zapier, and the native automations are fixed behaviors rather than a configurable rules engine. Missing for 10: a native user-definable trigger/condition/action rules builder, documented outbound webhooks or event triggers in the API, and hands-on corroboration of how deep the Zapier triggers and actions go.
